column1: # AUTOMATIC self-hosted programs: pages that the daily run downloads and reads (scripts/textscope.py).
# One line per program, columns separated by a TAB (2+ spaces also work):
#   program <TAB> program url <TAB> paying|non-paying|unknown <TAB> page url [<TAB> another page url ...]
# The page url may be left out when it is the program url. Use several page urls when the exclusions live on another page.
# Pages drawn by JavaScript (bughunters.google.com) give no text to a download: the run says "no scope found on ..." in the
# Sources table; for those paste the page text into config/self-hosted-text/ instead.
# Lines starting with # are ignored. Remove the # below to try it.
